trigger.description: A br read command observes .beads/issues.jsonl while another agent is rewriting it via br sync --flush-only, causing a one-read parse failure such as Invalid JSON at line N.

expected_emission.repair_string: Retry once through scripts/br_retry.sh ready --json; if the same parse error persists after retries, stop editing .beads/issues.jsonl and run br doctor --json before escalating.
